versions.changelog:
Initial release of skill-dropship-product-pipeline.

- Implements a full end-to-end pipeline for dropshipping products from CJ Dropshipping to WooCommerce, including margin checks and supplier mapping.
- Generates AI-powered hero images using Flux Kontext, with GPT-4o fallback.
- Supports keyword sourcing or direct CJ product ID input.
- Outputs JSON result with full cost/margin breakdown.
- Supports test mode (dry-run) and customizable margin/language options.
